text: Validators face consequences for disagreement with an unkeyed pool or error against a keyed result, but this only creates an incentive to match the recorded resolution and does not prove an unkeyed resolution correct.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Reinforcement Learning from Reputation Feedback (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=7456999
abstract: First, validators bear material consequences for disagreement with an unkeyed pool resolution or inaccuracy against a keyed outcome. This creates an incentive to match the recorded resolution, but it does not establish that an unkeyed resolution is externally correct.
